name: Swimming
summary: A full-body aquatic locomotion exercise that develops cardiovascular endurance and muscular stamina.

setup: Enter the pool lane and position yourself facing down along the lane line.
Engage your core to maintain a streamlined, horizontal posture near the water surface.
steps: Propel forward using coordinated arm strokes and leg kicks according to your chosen stroke technique.
Rotate your torso along your longitudinal axis to initiate each pull and facilitate efficient arm recovery.
Execute rhythmic kicks from the hips with relaxed ankles to provide continuous propulsion and maintain body position.
Turn or touch the wall at the end of each lap and continue for the prescribed distance or duration.
instructions.breathing: Exhale continuously underwater through your nose or mouth, turning your head smoothly into the bow wave to inhale during recovery without lifting your head.
cues: Kick from the hips, not the knees

common_faults.fault: Lifting the head excessively out of the water to breathe, which causes the hips and legs to drop.
common_faults.correction: Keep one goggle lens in the water while rotating laterally to breathe into the pocket created by your head.

common_faults.fault: Excessive knee bending during the kick, creating unwanted drag.
common_faults.correction: Initiate the flutter kick from the hips with relatively straight legs and relaxed ankles.

precautions: Only swim in supervised areas or with a lifeguard on duty.
Never swim alone or push beyond safe breath-holding limits.
